## `./Makefile`

### Generic: Files:

`generic-files-tracked-generate`: `generic-files-untracked-generate` render every git-tracked generated file (README, LICENSE, repo-specific tracked renders); the untracked set first, the tracked templates read it
`generic-files-untracked-generate` render every gitignored generated file (agent docs, repo data)
`generic-files-tracked-verify`: `generic-files-untracked-generate` regenerate the tracked files, fail on drift, restore the tree either way

### Generic: Env:

`generic-env-generate` render .che/tpl/repo-git-tracked/env.tpl to .env: missing keys only, existing values kept
`generic-env-update-dependencies` as generate, plus every upstream pin (.repo/upstream.env) overwritten
`generic-env-update-from-shell` as generate, plus every shell-valued key re-run (glab, op)
`generic-env-update-all` every template key overwritten, keys the template does not name kept

### Generic: Precommit:

`generic-precommit-install` install the lefthook git hooks
`generic-precommit-changed` run the pre-push checks over the files this branch changed against origin/main
`generic-precommit-all` run the pre-push checks over every file

### Generic: Deps:

`generic-deps-install` install the toolchain the generic targets need: make, lefthook, yq, glab (never che)

### Generic: Release:

`generic-semver-next` print the next semver tag inferred from the last tag..HEAD diff (override: `semver: major|minor|patch` commit token)
`generic-tag-mint` mint and push the next semver tag (CI: authed via TAG_TOKEN)

### Generic: Dev Environment:

`generic-dev-env-prepare`: `generic-env-generate -> generic-files-tracked-generate -> generic-deps-install -> generic-precommit-install` make a fresh clone a working checkout: .env, generated files, toolchain, git hooks

### Environment Variables:

`CHE_PROFILE=ai/host/macos|ai/base/macos|ai/virt/linux` force one che profile for host ops, passed as `$ che --profiles --skip-run-if`

### Setup:

`che-install` install the latest released che into ~/.local/bin, only when the one on PATH is older
`generic-setup` render the generic consumer payload (generic.mk, lefthook.yml, shared/generic/) at the pinned CENTRALIZED_ASSETS_GENERIC_REF
`shared/generic/make/generic.mk`: `generic-setup`

### Onto Repo:

`repo-prepare`: `repo-files-untracked-load -> repo-files-tracked-load` prepare the checkout: every repo-git-untracked profile, then every repo-git-tracked one
`repo-files-untracked-load` run every repo-git-untracked profile: gitignored renders, generic payload
`repo-files-tracked-load` run every repo-git-tracked profile: git-tracked renders (README, LICENSE)

### Onto Host:

`host-load-configs` load AI configs onto host, profile by profile: each profile's full op sequence minus scripts and package installs
`host-load-configs-install` install AI configs onto host, profile by profile: each profile's full op sequence, scripts included
